spots.line: Low beams, low talk, and every head turning at once.
The hearth has been kept in since before the raiding started.

chests.line: A traveller's pack left under the bench, and no traveller with it.

people.name: a farmhand three cups in
chatter: Forty for the room. Forty! I have slept in the field for nothing my whole life.
Mind the beam. Everyone says it after.

people.name: Merrow the Sword Monkey
chatter: Three swords. One for each of the last three arguments.
I drink here because the ogre does not water it.
